thread:
jenna_support: FYI — acct-917 reported free-tier + promo credits disappeared after weekly invoice ran. Dashboard shows 120 credits remaining but invoice line shows 0 credits applied. Customer is blocked.

mike_billing: Can you paste the invoice id and the account id? I can look up ledger entries.

jenna_support: invoice: INV-2026-0457, acct: acct-917. Customer said they saw 120 credits at 10:03 UTC then at 10:12 UTC the invoice consumed a different bucket and left balance 0. They attached a screenshot (not shared here).

sam_reliability: Ack — can you share the billing history JSON for acct-917? Specifically transactions around 10:00-10:20 UTC.

jenna_support: pasted snippet:

```
"billing_history": [
  {"ts": "2026-03-05T09:59:52Z", "type": "promo_grant", "promo_id": "PROMO-APR-2026", "amount": 120},
  {"ts": "2026-03-05T10:03:07Z", "type": "free_tier_credit", "amount": 50},
  {"ts": "2026-03-05T10:11:59Z", "type": "invoice_charge", "invoice_id": "INV-2026-0457", "applied_credits": 0, "charge": 12.34}
]
```

jenna_support: Also the dashboard UI shows: available_credits: 120 (top-right), but account.balance on the API returns 0 credits.

sam_reliability: Hmm — looks like applied_credits is 0 even though promo grant exists. Possible double-counting prevention or ordering bug in credit-application routine. Could be a race between promo expiry job and invoice generation.

mike_billing: I see billing_bot reported an automated expiry run at 10:12:05 UTC for PROMO-APR-2026 on multiple accounts. billing_bot, can you show the expiry job logs for acct-917?

billing_bot: Expiry job log excerpt for acct-917:

```
[2026-03-05T10:12:05Z] expire_promo PROMO-APR-2026 acct-917 status=marked_expired
[2026-03-05T10:12:06Z] notify ledger.lock_acquire success
[2026-03-05T10:12:07Z] expiry_complete acct-917
```

sam_reliability: Compare with invoice generation timestamp — invoice_charge at 10:11:59Z which is slightly earlier. There's a tiny window where invoice runs before we lock and apply credits, but the expiry job ran right after and marked promo as expired which may have cleared the grant before settling invoice rows.

mike_billing: That ordering could cause the invoice to miss applying promo credits if the ledger commit doesn't see the grant. Need to confirm transaction isolation and locking behavior; this smells like a race between the invoice job and the expiry job when they touch the same grant row.

sam_reliability: Quick repro steps for eng: 1) grant promo to acct, 2) schedule invoice job at t, 3) schedule expiry job at t+6s. Locally I can reproduce — when expiry marks grant expired within the commit window, invoice_applied_credits becomes 0.

sam_reliability: Proposed fix: change expiry job to acquire same ledger lock before changing status OR make invoice job re-check recently-expired grants within 1min window and treat them as still valid for that invoice run.

mike_billing: For this customer I'll do a manual credit restore and adjust ledger. Leaving a note so finance can review. Jenna, can you confirm customer ok with manual restore?

jenna_support: Customer confirmed they'd like the credits reinstated now.

mike_billing: Done — manually applied 120 promo credits to acct-917 and created adjustment ADJ-2026-789. Sent customer email. Marking incident for follow-up.

ops_bot: Created ticket: BILL-2026-143 to track root cause and code fix. Assigned to sam_reliability and eng-billing.

sam_reliability: I'll open a PR to hold expiry job lock and add an integration test for concurrent invoice/expiry. Also adding an audit log change to show jobs that touched grant rows.

mike_billing: Thanks — will coordinate with finance to reconcile invoice INV-2026-0457 and ensure no double refunds. Also asking product if we should surface a warning on dashboard when an invoice is in-flight and promo is expiring.

jenna_support: Customer acknowledged credit restore and able to continue. I'll close the Slack thread once BILL-2026-143 has a plan and ETA.

mike_billing: Follow-up: root cause accepted — race between expiry and invoice jobs. ETA for fix: 5 business days. Patch will add ledger lock and a 60s grace window for invoice credit application. :white_check_mark:
